title: The Pulse: new trend of building “internal vibe-coding apps” at tech companies
author: Ivan Klaric
description: Ramp and Stripe built platforms for non-engineers to build internal websites and tools with, and both are taking off in those workplaces. I expect more companies to do the same.
summary: Hi, this is Gergely with a bonus, free issue of the Pragmatic Engineer Newsletter. In every issue, I cover Big Tech and startups through the lens of senior engineers and engineering leaders.
takeaways: As of today, Ramp has launched Glass as an external product , describing it as "An AI workspace where knowledge compounds." It's interesting to see Ramp productionizing a formerly internal-only tool!
Among tech companies that have built their own coding agent harness that runs in their cloud, I expect many to build internal vibe-coding tools for non-engineers like Stripe and Ramp have done.
A software engineer working on OpenAI’s Agents SDK has been arrested after allegedly planting a secret audio recording device in a meeting room at the AI company.
